name: omnigent-vscode
description: Start an Omnigent server, run agents in integrated terminals, and open the WebUI — all from VS Code.

omnigent.agentConfigPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Omnigent agent config passed to `omnigent run <configPath>`. Used only when `#omnigent.profiles#` is empty.

extraArgs.description: Extra argv appended after the config path.

omnigent.profiles.markdownDescription: Agent profiles to launch from **Omnigent: Open Agent Terminal**. Each entry runs `omnigent run <configPath> [extraArgs...]` in a new terminal. Takes precedence over `#omnigent.agentConfigPath#`; a quick-pick appears when more than one is set.

omnigent.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Manual Omnigent server URL override (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:6767` or a remote `https://…`). Leave empty to auto-discover a locally running server. A **localhost** URL opens in the editor-beside WebUI pane; a **non-localhost** URL opens in the external browser (cookie/OIDC flows fail in the webview iframe).

omnigent.autoOpenUI.markdownDescription: When enabled, auto-open the Agent WebUI once a server URL is detected after **Start Server** or **Open Agent Terminal**.

enumDescriptions: Open the WebUI pane beside the active editor.
Open it in the active column.
omnigent.uiColumn.description: Where the local WebUI iframe pane opens.

enumDescriptions: Open agent/server terminals in the editor area.
Open them in the terminal panel.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Start or run Omnigent from VS Code.
[Start Server](command:omnigent.startServer)
[Open Agent Terminal](command:omnigent.openAgentTerminal)
[Open Agent WebUI](command:omnigent.openAgentWebUI)
Or set `omnigent.serverUrl` to point at a running server.
